body.x: JJTech has displayed ‘Feeling Pen’ and ‘Feeling Pen & Oringa’ in front of 150 guests in the industry and foreign media at the event MIK Innovation Night 2019 on January 10, which was held during CES 2019, the world’s largest technology exhibition in Las Vegas, USA.

This company, basing on a new concept of educational material production and program development, is an EdTech company which has shown educational materials combined with educational contents steadily since its founding year of 2017.
Electronic pen applied with heptic technology can maximize children’s interest by fusing educational gaming contents with an electronic pen.
The existing device used for smart education relays on senses of hearing and watching while this product added with a sense of touch on top of other senses to create sensory-friendly education.

Smart media education supports three senses: touch, hear, and see; at the same time, it encourages interest-intriguing factor and sensory-friendly environment. The LED installation provides product usage environment where colors change into various options depending on its use.

AVING NEWS and GMEG, a global company specializing in MICE have planned together and co-hosted MIK Innovation Hot Spot. MIK Innovation Hot Spot is made as the global project zone to give boost to startups in Korea to enter the global market. With the space provided for exhibition and pitching, it runs various programs and parties. They also hosted their first global network event MIK Innovation Night in Las Vegas.
2019 CES is an innovative place where the tech companies that will be leading fourth industrial revolution future are attending.
